metadata.description: Claude Code-led multi-model teamwork: foreman (中文) and foreman-en (English)

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Claude Code 主导的多模型协作：讨论、执行、审查各按难度分级，把编码工作派给 Codex、opencode、pi 和 API 模型并验收，请其他模型独立审查、一起讨论复杂方案；图形素材走出图和手画流程，网页看板实时显示各模型的进度、用量和费用。（中文版）

plugins.name: foreman-en
plugins.description: Claude Code-led multi-model teamwork: levels each discussion, hands-on task and review by difficulty, hands coding work to Codex, opencode, pi and API models and checks the results, gets independent reviews and multi-model discussions of complex designs, runs graphics through image generation and drawing, and shows every model's progress, usage and cost live on a web board. (English)
